SELECT r.*, m.name AS material_name FROM material_record r LEFT JOIN material m ON r.material_id = m.material_id ORDER BY r.record_time DESC, r.record_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO material_record (material_id, type, quantity, usage_desc, operator, record_time) VALUES (#{materialId}, #{type}, #{quantity}, #{usageDesc}, #{operator}, NOW())
